description: Source code for a firmware utility tool that creates firmware images with partitions and blocks, including CRC calculations, argument parsing, and file writing functions.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that parses arguments, processes files and partitions, and writes the firmware image.

methods.name: init_crc_table
methods.description: Initializes the CRC-32 lookup table.

methods.name: update_crc
methods.description: Updates CRC value with given data buffer.

methods.name: get_crc
methods.description: Calculates CRC for a data buffer.

methods.name: find_board
methods.description: Finds a board configuration by model name.

methods.name: errmsg
methods.description: Prints an error message with optional system error string.

methods.name: errmsgv
methods.description: Variadic version of errmsg for formatted output.

methods.name: dbgmsg
methods.description: Prints debug messages based on verbosity level.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information and options.

methods.name: parse_arg
methods.description: Parses colon-separated argument string into tokens.

methods.name: required_arg
methods.description: Checks if an argument is provided for an option.

methods.name: is_empty_arg
methods.description: Checks if an argument string is empty.

methods.name: parse_opt_flags
methods.description: Parses firmware flags option.

methods.name: parse_opt_size
methods.description: Parses flash size option.

methods.name: parse_opt_id
methods.description: Parses vendor, device, subvendor, subdevice IDs, and revision.

methods.name: parse_opt_block
methods.description: Parses block configuration options.

methods.name: parse_opt_partition
methods.description: Parses partition configuration options.

methods.name: parse_opt_board
methods.description: Sets board configuration based on model name.

methods.name: parse_opt_rev
methods.description: Sets board revision.

methods.name: process_files
methods.description: Validates and processes block files.

methods.name: process_partitions
methods.description: Validates partition configurations.

methods.name: write_out_data
methods.description: Writes data buffer to output file and updates CRC.

methods.name: write_out_desc
methods.description: Writes block descriptor to output file.

methods.name: write_out_padding
methods.description: Writes padding bytes to align data.

methods.name: write_out_file
methods.description: Writes a file's data into the firmware image, including headers if needed.

methods.name: write_out_header
methods.description: Writes the firmware header to the output file.

methods.name: write_out_partitions
methods.description: Writes partition table and related data.

methods.name: write_out_blocks
methods.description: Writes block descriptors and block data.
